# Brief: flow sessions, the "way in" item, and fallback-card scrolling (Twyne)

You are working in /home/diogenes/Projects/twyne (Qwik + TipTap + Convex, Bun).
Another agent (Claude) is building the UI for these features **at the same time**
in other files. Stay inside the files you own. Do NOT commit, do NOT run
`git stash`, `git checkout`, `git reset`, or any formatter over the whole repo.
The working tree has many unrelated uncommitted changes: leave them alone.

Do NOT start a Vite dev server (one is already running on 127.0.0.1:5180 and a
second one corrupts the shared `node_modules/.vite` cache). Do not run
Playwright e2e. Verify with `npx tsc --noEmit -p .` (filter to your files) and
`bun test <file>` run ONE FILE AT A TIME (the full suite has known cross-file
flakes). `npx eslint <your files>` too.

## Files you own

- `src/components/editor/extensions/flow-conductor.ts`
- `src/components/editor/extensions/flow-conductor.test.ts`
- `src/utils/flow-session.ts` (keep the existing exported types, field names and
  `FLOW_SESSION_EVENT` exactly as they are; you may ADD pure helpers)
- new `src/utils/flow-session.test.ts`
- `src/utils/flow-items.ts` — only `decideSurface`/`scoreItem` if the way-in item
  needs policy changes (the `"way-in"` kind, its label, side and priority are
  already added; keep them)
- `src/utils/flow-policy.test.ts`
- `src/components/editor/twyne-editor.tsx` — only for task 3
- `src/components/editor/popover-positioning.ts` + its test — only if task 3 needs it
- `src/routes/house/index.tsx` — only for task 4
- `docs/flow-and-context.md` — task 5
- new unit test files for `flow-state.ts`, `flow-profile.ts`, `margin-surface.ts`

Claude owns (do not edit): `src/components/in-flow/*`, `src/global.css`,
`src/components/editor/manuscript-panel.tsx`, `src/components/house/house.css`.

## Background

Read `docs/flow-and-context.md` first. `flow-conductor.ts` reads typing cadence
(`flow-state.ts` → modes `away | working | settling | flow | stuck`), learns the
writer's thresholds (`flow-profile.ts`), gathers margin items (echoes, works,
shelf, charter, amendments…) with budgeted Jev (System One) calls via `ask()`,
and publishes a `FlowSnapshot` on `FLOW_EVENT`. `FlowSnapshot.heldKinds` was just
added (a tally of held items by kind); keep it.

## Task 1 — flow sessions (the "galley slip")

When the page enters `flow` mode, open a session; when it leaves flow (to any
other mode), when the writer releases focus (Escape / reaching / manual zen
off), or when the conductor stops (editor destroyed / folio change), close it.
Build a `FlowSession` (see `src/utils/flow-session.ts`):

- `flowMs`: time from entering flow to leaving it.
- `words`: net words added during the session (the conductor already tracks
  inserted/deleted chars per transaction; count words with the same 5.5
  chars/word used by `wordsSinceDrift`, or better, diff the doc's word count
  at start vs end — choose the more honest one, never negative).
- `wpm`: words / minutes, rounded.
- `waited`: how many distinct items were upserted or held while the session
  was open (i.e. what the quiet page kept from the writer).
- `amendments`: amendment items proposed during the session.
- `ended`: map the cause to `FlowSessionEnd`.

Only announce sessions worth a slip: `flowMs >= 60_000` (or `words >= 40`).
Dispatch `new CustomEvent<FlowSession>(FLOW_SESSION_EVENT, { detail })` on
`window`, log it with `logFlow("focus", ...)`, and persist the last 30 sessions
to IndexedDB meta key `"flow-sessions"` using the existing helpers in
`src/utils/idb.ts` (`saveMetaToIdb`, `loadMetaFromIdb`, `toStorable`). IMPORTANT:
never put Qwik store proxies into IDB (DataCloneError fails silently); build
plain objects and use `toStorable`. Add a pure, tested helper in
`flow-session.ts`, e.g. `summarizeSession(...)` and `appendSession(list, s, max)`,
plus `loadFlowSessions()`.

Also add `lastSession(): FlowSession | null` to the `FlowController` interface
so the margin can show the most recent slip after a remount.

## Task 2 — "a way in" when stuck

`gather()` already asks Jev `questions.stuck` when `mode === "stuck"` but never
uses the answer. When the writer is stuck and Jev confirms (noul ≥ 0.6, or when
no client is available, fall back to the local reading only if the struggle
signal is strong), upsert ONE item:

```ts
{ id: `way-in:${key.slice(0, 40)}`, kind: "way-in", anchors: [text],
  title: <short prompt>, body: <one or two sentences>, byline?: string,
  links?: [<id of the best echo item for this passage, if any>], createdAt, relevance }
```

System One returns typed judgements, not prose, so pick the prompt with a
`choice` question from a fixed set of ways in, and fill the body from a
template that uses the dossier (`stack.fields.goal/audience`) and the
passage. Suggested set (tune the wording; keep it short, warm, never bossy):

- "Say it plainly first" — write the sentence as you'd say it to <audience>, then dress it.
- "Start from the thing itself" — one concrete detail you can see.
- "Who is this for?" — <goal / audience line from the dossier>.
- "Pick up an earlier thread" — only offered when an echo matched; link it.
- "Leave a mark and move on" — type TK and write the next paragraph.

Only one way-in at a time; dismissing it must keep it dismissed for that
passage. It should rank first while stuck (priority is already 0.95), and it
should not be offered in any other mode (make `decideSurface` hold it outside
`stuck`, with a reason string). Add policy tests.

## Task 3 — fallback conversation cards follow their passage

On screens where the flow margin is not active (`marginSurface()` returns null),
the comment / persona-note / suggestion popovers are placed once with
`computeMarginCardGeometry` (which now tucks the card under or over the passage
when there is no margin room) and then stay fixed while the manuscript scrolls.
Make them follow their passage on scroll/resize (rAF-throttled, passive
listener on the manuscript scroller, found the same way `flow-surface.tsx`
finds it: `.page-canvas` parent). Only for popovers whose `margin` is null. If
the passage scrolls fully out of the viewport and the card has no unsent
draft and is not pinned, close it; otherwise clamp it on screen. Keep the
existing `margin`-slot path untouched.

## Task 4 — House engine room

In `src/routes/house/index.tsx`, in the existing engine-room / diagnostics tab,
add a small "Galley slips" list of the recent `flow-sessions` (date, folio name
if resolvable, minutes in flow, words, wpm, items that waited, how it ended).
Reuse existing classes from that page; don't add CSS (tell me which class names
you used so I can style them). Beware Qwik optimizer gotchas documented in
comments in that file: no tuple destructuring in `.map` callbacks that feed
event handlers; build fragment JSX lazily (functions), not as eager constants.

## Task 5 — docs and tests

- Update `docs/flow-and-context.md`: sessions/galley slip, the way-in item, the
  pneumatic-post tally (`heldKinds`), and the fallback-card scrolling.
- Unit tests: `flow-session` helpers, way-in policy, and (if time) `flow-state`
  `readFlow` transitions, `flow-profile` threshold learning, `margin-surface`
  register/unregister/`marginSurface()` gating.

## When done

Print a short report: files changed, the public API you added (names +
signatures), class names used in the House page, test results, and anything
you could not verify.
I’ll read the flow docs and current code, then implement within your file boundaries. I’ll use the requested targeted checks and leave the running server and unrelated changes alone.
The docs confirm the quiet-page behavior. I’m using the TypeSafe skill for the “way in” choice question, and I’ll measure session words from the document’s start/end word counts.

I’ll close sessions on flow exit and focus release, count waiting items by distinct ID, and retain the last 30 qualifying slips. A “way in” will stay passage-specific: Jev must confirm it, with local fallback only when there’s no client and churn is strong.

The session lifecycle and fallback-card listeners are implemented, along with the House “Galley slips” list. I’ll now test session endings and remounts, late Jev answers, dismissals, and the rules for keeping cards on screen.

+### Galley slips
+
+Entering `flow` opens a session. Leaving for any other reading closes it; Escape,
+reaching for the room, turning focus off, disabling automatic focus, destroying
+the editor or changing folios closes it too. A session worth remembering lasts
+at least one minute **or** adds forty net words. Shorter runs leave no slip.
+
+The slip records its folio, start and end, time in flow, net document word growth
+(never negative), rounded words per minute, distinct items upserted or held while
+the page was quiet, newly proposed amendments, and how the run ended: a pause,
+reaching, a manual exit, stepping away, or closing the folio. Repeated updates to
+the same item count once; an amendment already waiting before flow does not count
+as a new proposal. Words written before entering flow do not belong to the slip.
+
+The conductor announces qualifying slips on `twyne:flow-session` and logs them as
+focus decisions. The last thirty are saved as plain objects in IndexedDB meta
+`flow-sessions`; no Qwik store proxies enter that history. `loadFlowSessions()`
+reads it and `FlowController.lastSession()` restores the latest slip for the
+current folio after a remount. The House's Engine room lists recent slips by date,
+folio, minutes, words, pace, what waited and how the run ended; its JSON export
+includes them. Slips and cadence profiles remain on this device.
+
+### A way in, and the pneumatic post
+
+While stuck, Jev's unresolved-passage Noul must reach 0.6 before a single **A way
+in** item is offered. In the same budgeted request, a Choice selects a short prompt
+from fixed options: say it plainly, start with a concrete detail, return to the
+audience and purpose, pick up an earlier thread, or leave TK and move on. Code
+supplies the wording from templates and the dossier; System One selects rather
+than writes prose. The earlier-thread option needs an actual matched echo, and
+the card links the best available echo for its passage.
+
+With no client, a local stuck reading can supply the plain-sentence prompt only
+after strong churn (at least 0.6) and the writer's learned stuck pause. A configured
+client's budget skip or failed judgement does not count as confirmation. Late
+answers cannot offer help after the passage or mode changes. Only one way-in item
+is live at once; dismissing it keeps it dismissed for that passage during the
+mounted conductor session. It leads while stuck and waits, with an explicit
+policy reason, in every other reading or at another passage.
+
+`FlowSnapshot.heldKinds` is the pneumatic post's tally: held items by kind, beside
+the total `held`. It includes only policy-held items, including a waiting way in;
+dismissed items do not count. The margin can name what is waiting without showing
+the cards during a quiet run.

Implemented sessions, stuck-only way-ins using fixed [Choice prompts](https://docs.typesafe.ai/primitives/choice), fallback-card scrolling, House slips, and docs/tests.

Files changed:

- Editor: [flow-conductor.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/editor/extensions/flow-conductor.ts), `flow-conductor.test.ts`, [twyne-editor.tsx](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/components/editor/twyne-editor.tsx), `popover-positioning.ts`, `popover-positioning.test.ts`.
- Utilities: [flow-session.ts](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/utils/flow-session.ts), `flow-session.test.ts`, `flow-items.ts`, `flow-policy.test.ts`; new `flow-state.test.ts`, `flow-profile.test.ts`, `margin-surface.test.ts`.
- [House route](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/routes/house/index.tsx) and [flow docs](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/docs/flow-and-context.md).

Public API added, plus input types `SessionSummaryInput` and `FallbackCardView`:

```ts
summarizeSession(input: SessionSummaryInput): FlowSession | null
appendSession(list: readonly FlowSession[], session: FlowSession, max?: number): FlowSession[]
loadFlowSessions(): Promise<FlowSession[]>
FlowController.lastSession(): FlowSession | null
computeFallbackCardGeometry(view: FallbackCardView): PopoverGeometry | null
```

House classes reused: `house-sheet`, `house-section__head`, `house-section__title`, `house-section__note`, `house-empty`, `house-register`, `house-log`, `house-register__row`, `house-register__when`, `house-register__what`, `house-register__diff`, `house-register__why`. No CSS added.

Verification: **65 tests passed across seven files**, run individually. ESLint passed. TypeScript reports **zero errors in owned files**; the full check reports two errors in [src/routes/docs/index.tsx:565](/home/diogenes/Projects/twyne/src/routes/docs/index.tsx:565).

Browser rendering/scrolling, live Jev, and real IndexedDB persistence were not exercised; storage tests used mocks. No commit, server startup, or Playwright e2e run.
